recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It finishes the already-approved FHIR-53486 page edits while respecting the current build scope and the prior move of FormularyItem out of active core resources.
issue_request: FHIR-53486 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-core change request from PHER for the Medications Module page. It requested typo fixes, new Normative Resources and Additional Resources subsections in section 11.0.2, moving FormularyItem, ImmunizationEvaluation, and ImmunizationRecommendation to Additional Resources, updated descriptions for the immunization additional resources, and reordered common use cases so medication use cases precede immunization use cases.
initial_application: Commit 4339778eb3f56eda5d28a552377b5185197b69ed partially applied the issue by fixing two listed typos, adding an Additional Resources table for ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation, updating those descriptions, and moving medication use cases before immunization use cases. Commit 2b1fe4c966ab0534ff1397cb94e46f4a70e4c086 added ballot-note text linking those page changes to FHIR-53486. The current source still omitted FormularyItem from the Additional Resources table, retained separate Medications/Immunizations headings instead of the requested Normative/Additional split, and kept the typo "as while reviewing a patients' medication list."
additional_context: The Medications module page is in current build scope via source/hierarchy.xml. FormularyItem was removed from active core build registration by 9987f9c0c3ce5ec4f277c22ed71cbb2d210efeb6 and the module page already linked it to the PHX incubator, so this reconciliation treats it as an external Additional Resource rather than restoring retired core resource registration. PHWG Confluence minutes for 2025-12-11 record FHIR-53486 as persuasive with changes as suggested and a 28-0-1 vote. A quoted Zulip search for the issue and module found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/medications-module.html to mention both Normative Resources and Additional Resources in the ballot note, replace the separate Medications/Immunizations resource-table headings with the requested Normative Resources section, keep the active core Immunization row with other normative resources, add FormularyItem to the Additional Resources table with its PHX-incubator link and formulary-specific description, preserve the existing ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation additional-resource descriptions, and correct the remaining use-case typo to "stand-alone request or while reviewing a patient's medication list."
source_changes: source/medications-module.html: updated the ballot note to refer to Normative Resources and Additional Resources sections.
source/medications-module.html: replaced separate Medications and Immunizations resource headings with a Normative Resources section containing the active core resources.
source/medications-module.html: added FormularyItem to the Additional Resources table with its external PHX-incubator link and a formulary-specific description.
source/medications-module.html: corrected the remaining common-use-case typo from "as while reviewing a patients' medication list" to "while reviewing a patient's medication list".
